The crystal structure is face-centered cubic (FCC).
The lattice parameter is a = 0.404 nm.
The Burgers vector of a perfect dislocation in an FCC lattice is a/2[110], which is the shortest lattice translation in the close-packed direction.
The magnitude of the Burgers vector is b = (a/2) * sqrt(2) = a / sqrt(2).
Substitute a = 0.404 nm to compute b = 0.404 / 1.4142 = 0.2857 nm.
Report the final answer as b ≈ 0.286 nm.
